question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

The art of preserving an animal's body by stuffing or mounting.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e., **Taxidermy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Taxidermy"** refers to the art of preserving an animal's body (either whole or part) by stuffing or mounting it for display purposes. (जानवर की त्वचा को भरने या सजाने की कला)
 
 
• **Example:** The museum has an impressive collection of taxidermy animals, including a lion and a polar bear.
 
 
• Taxidermy is often used in museums, educational exhibits, and even by hunters to preserve trophies.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Taxidermy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Scrimshaw** (स्क्रिमशॉ): The art of carving or engraving on bones or ivory, traditionally practiced by sailors.
 
 
• **Example:** The sailor spent his free time creating beautiful scrimshaw designs on whale bones.
 
 

 
• **Oshibana** (ओशिबाना): The Japanese art of creating pictures using pressed flowers and plants.
 
 
• **Example:** Her oshibana artwork of cherry blossoms is truly breathtaking.
 
 

 
• **Plastination** (प्लास्टिनेशन): A technique used in anatomy to preserve bodies or body parts by replacing water and fat with plastics.
 
 
• **Example:** The plastination technique is widely used in anatomy labs for educational purposes.
